### 🟡 Changes recommended

A critical integration-test networking issue and a moderate proxy-isolation test gap remain.

*Get a fresh assessment by requesting another Copilot review.*

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

### Suppressed comments (5)

**src/devops_ai/secrets/providers/openbao.py:235**
* This new error message is grammatically malformed (`{name} names`) and makes it unclear that `{name}` identifies the setting containing the CA-bundle path. Please reword it to say that the bundle is named by the variable.
```
                f"Cannot read the CA bundle {name} names ({cafile}): "
```
**src/devops_ai/secrets/providers/openbao.py:350**
* When the caller uses the supported `VAULT_TOKEN` spelling and receives a 401/403, this remediation only tells them to export `BAO_TOKEN`. That is misleading for the documented Vault-compatible path; mention both accepted variables (or pass the selected token source through) so the guidance matches the configuration the provider accepts.
```
        return ProviderError(
            f"OpenBao refused the token for {ref} (HTTP {code}). Run "
            f"`bao login`, or export a BAO_TOKEN with read access."
        )
```
**src/devops_ai/secrets/providers/openbao.py:365**
* The redirect error hard-codes `BAO_ADDR`, so a user who configured the supported `VAULT_ADDR` spelling is told to change a different variable. The JSON error above already names `server.variable`; this status path should likewise mention the selected variable or both accepted spellings.
```
            return ProviderError(
                f"The server redirected {ref} to a different host (HTTP "
                f"{code}), which a token must not follow. Point BAO_ADDR at "
                f"the server that holds the secret."
```
**tests/integration/test_secrets_openbao.py:390**
* This test name reads as an incomplete sentence and does not clearly identify the behavior under test: redirects with no cross-host hop (missing `Location` or a loop) should report an unfollowable redirect. Rename it to make that scope explicit.
```
    def test_a_redirect_the_token_was_never_at_stake_in_says_so(
```
**tests/integration/test_secrets_openbao.py:448**
* `ProxyHandler` checks `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy` before using the configured proxy. Because both test servers use `127.0.0.1`, an inherited no-proxy entry lets the request go directly to `bao` even if `ProxyHandler({})` is removed, so this regression test can pass without proving that the token cannot reach a proxy. Clear both no-proxy variables or use a host that is not bypassed.
```
        for name in ("HTTP_PROXY", "http_proxy", "ALL_PROXY", "all_proxy"):
            monkeypatch.setenv(name, seen.addr)
```

</details>

## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended State integrity, lifecycle semantics, commit validation, and J10 grader escapes remain unresolved. *Get a fresh assessment by requesting another Copilot review.* **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** 2 · 1
Open (3) - [Authenticate state comments and define duplicate handling](#discussion_r4057523697) · New - [Persist stopped state atomically during apply](#discussion_r4057523710) · New - [Require closing fences to contain only trailing whitespace](#discussion_r4057523731) · New
Resolved since last review (6) - [Normalize internal shell escapes before command classification](#discussion_r4057289676) - [Distinguish closing fences from same-length info markers](#discussion_r4057289714) - [Cap read-side round calls at MEASURED_UNTIL](#discussion_r4057289699) - [Define verdict behavior for continuing manual reports](#discussion_r4057289686) - [Update stale J10_CASES counts and category totals](#discussion_r4057289732) - [Clarify the exception to M1's frontmatter pin invariant](#discussion_r4057289722)
Previously missed (7) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Require checkout HEAD to match the PR head SHA `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M1-read-side.md:50` `matches_pr` can be true for a stale or locally-ahead checkout solely because its branch name equals `head_ref`. `status` may therefore return `ready` while the packet describes the remote PR head but fixes are made against a different local tree. This also contradicts the current `kreview` skill's requirement that “HEAD must be the PR head” (`skills/kreview/SKILL.md:182`). Require `HEAD == head_sha`; keep the branch name diagnostic, and cover a same-name divergent checkout.
Define grouping for isolated findings without root causes `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M2-the-loop.md:72` `root_cause` is forbidden for `isolated` dispositions, but issue grouping is defined solely as “findings with the same root_cause share one issue.” The Surface therefore does not say whether two isolated OUT_OF_SCOPE findings (both lacking `root_cause`) create one issue or two, and no test covers that combination. Define isolated findings as distinct classes (or require another grouping key) and add the corresponding case.
Validate fix commits belong to the PR commit range `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M2-the-loop.md:75` “Reachable from the PR head” accepts every base-branch ancestor, so an `IMPLEMENT` disposition can name an old commit that is not part of the PR and the tool will still resolve the thread as `Fixed in `. Validate that the commit belongs to the PR's commit range (and define any ordering requirement relative to the finding), not merely that it is an ancestor of the head; the foreign-all-zero-SHA test does not catch this case.
Bound or compact cumulative issue comment state `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M2-the-loop.md:167` The block retains every round from every run in one issue comment, while A9 explicitly has no cumulative run cap. GitHub issue-comment bodies are finite, so repeated re-entry (or a few large rounds) will eventually make the comment update fail and strand the only durable ledger. Define compaction/archive behavior or bounded state that preserves the inherited ledger before committing to one ever-growing comment.
Count only Copilot requests toward paid rounds `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M2-the-loop.md:172` This metric counts any requested reviewer as a paid round because state records only `requested_at`, yet the Surface supports `--reviewer LOGIN` for human reviewers. A human request would therefore inflate both `paid_rounds_this_run` and the report's paid-round total. Persist the requested reviewer/type and count only Copilot requests (or rename the metric if all requests are intended).
Make comment parsing quote-aware `tests/​acceptance/​review_loop_runtime/​test_m2_the_loop.py:1727` This comment regex is not quote-aware despite the preceding claim. For example, in `printf "%s" "prefix #"; gh api repos/x/y`, the space before the quoted `#` matches and removes the rest of the line, so both J10 graders miss the real `gh` command. Parse comments only outside quotes and add this quoted-space case to `J10_CASES`.
Align token handling invariant with gh authentication `docs/​specs/​review-loop-runtime/​briefs/​M1-read-side.md:267` This invariant is stronger than the chosen authentication mechanism can guarantee. `gh` commonly authenticates from an inherited `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN`, so a normal subprocess inherits a token in its environment; stripping those variables can in turn make CI authentication fail. Align this with D1's actual guarantee—that `kreview` does not read, construct, log, or add a token and delegates authentication to `gh`—or explicitly require credential-store-only authentication and test the sanitized environment.

## Copilot review overview ### 🔵 Needs a closer look Contradictory stop terminology and outdated effort parsing could cause incorrect loop behavior and reports. **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** None
Resolved since last review (2) - [Require naming the oscillation signal in the report](#discussion_r4058862460) - [Document framework stop-mechanics changes in authoritative docs](#discussion_r4058862445)
Previously missed (3) In code that hasn't changed since last review
Clarify no-budget rule for explicit max-rounds `skills/​kbabysit/​SKILL.md:447` An explicit `max-rounds:` is still a per-run budget, so “There is no budget” contradicts the new stop rule at lines 398–400 and can cause the supplied ceiling to be ignored when reasoning about bounds. Qualify this as the no-explicit-ceiling case; the three listed safeguards then remain accurate.
Support both Review effort footer formats `skills/​kbabysit/​SKILL.md:510` Current Copilot review bodies do not always use the format consumed by step 2. PR #66 already has v2 bodies containing `**Review effort:** Balanced`, while lines 277–279 only match the older `Review effort level:**` footer; under the existing instructions this newly emphasized value is therefore reported as `?` despite being present. Extend the step-2 extractor to accept both formats before requiring this field to be read from the body.
Clarify terminal stop versus waiting for human input `skills/​kbabysit/​SKILL.md:372` This absolute rule conflicts with the immediately following “Stop — wait on the human” section: pinned Surface, DISCUSS, explicit `max-rounds:`, and red CI all end the current session and require re-entry. Because this skill drives agent behavior, overloading “stop” to mean both terminal convergence/divergence and a human wait leaves two incompatible instructions. Please distinguish “conclude/diverge” from “pause for human input” consistently here, in the waiting heading, and in the report terminology.

## Pull request overview Adds a sandbox provisioning layer to `kinfra impl` worktrees so application-level dependencies (secrets, gitignored config files, and non-sensitive env vars) are set up before `docker compose up`, with a recovery command (`kinfra sandbox start`) for retrying after provisioning failures. **Changes:** - Extend `InfraConfig` to parse `[sandbox.env]`, `[sandbox.secrets]`, and `[sandbox.files]` from `infra.toml`. - Add provisioning runtime (`provision.py`) and integrate it into `kinfra impl`, plus a new `kinfra sandbox start` recovery command. - Update compose startup to support multiple `--env-file` inputs and generate `.env.secrets` alongside `.env.sandbox`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.
